name: 20283-batchdecode-qwen3next80b-tp4
parallelism: TP=4, EP=1, PP=1, DP=1. One node, no router, no external cache tier.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=192, warmup the first 25%, bounded at 1152 requests with an 1800 s safety cap.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix structure: 2048 prompt tokens in, 1024 generated out, both fixed. Unique prompts, radix cache off. Seed 0.
purpose: A long-form content generator writing 1024-token drafts from 2048-token briefs for 192 concurrent users on four GPUs.
launch:
# sglang engine arguments: four GPUs of one node, unquantized bf16, 192 streams in flight.

model-path: Qwen/Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B-Instruct
tp-size: 4
mem-fraction-static: 0.85

# The admission ceiling, set above the 192 the load profile runs at so the load can walk up
# without editing the declaration.
max-running-requests: 320

disable-radix-cache: true
chunked-prefill-size: 8192

# Capped at the admission ceiling rather than left at the tp>=4 default of 512, whose top
# buckets are unreachable here.
cuda-graph-max-bs: 320

random-seed: 0
